name: cache-watch
description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm and suggests compacting a large context at the right moment

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request. Claude Code uses 60; the mod switches to 5 on its own when the server shows a shorter lifetime.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before expiry (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: While idle with a large context, suggest compacting this many minutes before the cache expires.

statusFromTokens.title: Show status from (tokens)
statusFromTokens.description: The status line appears from this context size on, and below it only while the cache is about to expire.

largeContextTokens.title: Large context (tokens)
largeContextTokens.description: From this context size on, the mod suggests compacting at milestones, before the cache expires and before a prompt on a cold cache.
